mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from coin_ledger where user_id = #{userId} and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from coin_ledger where user_id = #{userId} and amount > 0 and expires_at is not null and expires_at > now()
select * from coin_ledger where user_id = #{userId} and amount > 0 and expires_at is not null and expires_at > now() order by expires_at asc, id asc for update
select * from coin_ledger where amount > 0 and expires_at is not null and expires_at <= now() order by expires_at asc, id asc
select * from coin_ledger where user_id = #{userId} and ref_order_id = #{orderId} and source = 'CHECKOUT_SPEND' order by id asc
